description: Supper, and a verdict already given

participation.context: Said the afternoon was the company's, kept Thursday's verdict as she had given it, and named no new errand.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Carried the pot, withheld a ruling on The Shrew, and left the latch where it was.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Asked about dinner and the ladies, and did not take a house candle.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Said he had seen the afternoon bill and had not stayed.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.note: she will not rule The Shrew off one sentence
relations.quote: I will not rule it off a single sentence.

story.body: You told the house you were not in The Shrew. Mistress Ansell refused a verdict on one sentence and kept her January ruling. The latch was left on the door. You said the letter waits for the twenty-seventh.

title: Supped at home
